data.narrative:
Intramotev is a Series A autonomous systems company operating within the Drones & Autonomous sector. The company has raised $14.4M to date. The relevant comp universe consists of 8 private companies in the sector, including peers such as Waymo, Wayve, Zipline, Joby Aviation, and Nuro. No public comparables exist in this specific subsector.

Given the early-stage nature of the target and lack of sufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage peers meeting statistical thresholds, the Peer-Median approach was not applicable; a broader sector median would introduce unacceptable noise across heterogeneous business models and maturity levels. Instead, valuation relies on Stage-Progression methodology. This method applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier to the $14.4M total raised proxy, reflecting typical Series A to next-stage appreciation. This yields an implied valuation of $28.8M.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $24M to $33M, with a median point of $29M. This range incorporates reasonable variance around a single-method result but should be interpreted with caution given reliance on a single applicable triangulation method. Key uncertainties include the absence of meaningful peer-stage transaction data, the heterogeneity of autonomous systems business models (which may render stage-progression multipliers insufficiently precise), and unknown specific metrics regarding Intramotev's revenue, runway, or technical differentiation relative to the comp set.
